description: Change part of a script without resending all of it: replaces an exact piece of text with new text.

new_text.description: Text to put in its place.

old_text.description: Exact text to find (must be in the script).

path.description: Instance path such as "game.Workspace.Model.Part" or "game.ServerScriptService.Main". Services are found by name.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one (default false).
